name: Prospeo
summary: Find and verify emails and mobiles, enrich people and companies, and search a B2B people and company database.

api_key.description: A Prospeo API key (Prospeo dashboard > API). Sent in the X-KEY header.

notes: Almost every call is a POST with a JSON body; bodies carry the filters or the person to match.
Charged only on results: 1 credit per email found, 10 per mobile, 1 per search page with results; repeats within 90 days (enrich) or 30 days (search pages) are free.
Search results never include emails or mobiles; enrich a person to get them.

endpoints.name: Get account information
endpoints.summary: Plan, remaining and used credits, renewal date.

endpoints.name: Enrich a person
endpoints.summary: Match one person and return profile, company and email, optionally a mobile.

only_verified_email.description: Return only records with a verified email. Default false.

enrich_mobile.description: Reveal the mobile number if one exists (10 credits).

only_verified_mobile.description: Return only records with a mobile; also sets enrich_mobile. Default false.

data.description: Person to match: first_name, last_name, full_name, linkedin_url, email (work), company_name, company_website, company_linkedin_url, person_id (from search). Needs first_name+last_name+a company field, or full_name+a company field, or linkedin_url, or email, or person_id.

notes: A read over POST: nothing is changed.

1 credit per email found (covers person and company data); a mobile adds up to 10 credits per mobile found. No charge when nothing is found, or when the same record is re-enriched within 90 days (free_enrichment in the answer says so).

endpoints.name: Enrich up to 50 people

only_verified_email.description: Return only records with a verified email. Default false.

enrich_mobile.description: Reveal the mobile number if one exists (10 credits).

only_verified_mobile.description: Return only records with a mobile; also sets enrich_mobile. Default false.

data.description: Up to 50 objects, each with a required identifier (your own alphanumeric string) plus the same matching fields as enrich_person.

notes: A read over POST: nothing is changed.
Credits only for matches returned, same rules as people.enrich; total_cost in the answer is the request total. Records that fail the matching rules come back in invalid_datapoints.

endpoints.name: Enrich a company
endpoints.summary: Company profile from a website, LinkedIn URL, name or id.

data.description: Object with at least one of company_website, company_linkedin_url, company_name (weak on its own), company_id.

notes: A read over POST: nothing is changed.
1 credit per matched company; none when no match or on re-enrichment within 90 days.

endpoints.name: Search people
endpoints.summary: Filter people by title, seniority, department, location and company attributes. Emails and mobiles are not returned.

filters.description: Filter object. Most keys take include and/or exclude lists: person_seniority, person_department, person_job_title, person_location_search, company_industry, company_headcount_range, company_technology, company_location_search, plus company.names and company.websites (up to 500 each). An exclude-only search is not allowed.

notes: A read over POST: nothing is changed.
1 credit per request that returns at least one person; a page already paid for in the last 30 days is free ("free": true). Max 25,000 results per query.
Enum filters accept only predefined values; location and job title values must match search_suggestions output exactly.

endpoints.name: Search companies

filters.description: Filter object, same style as people.search company filters.

notes: A read over POST: nothing is changed.
1 credit per request that returns at least one company; a page already paid for in the last 30 days is free.

endpoints.name: Get valid filter values
endpoints.summary: Valid location, job title, technology, industry, NAICS or SIC strings for search filters.

location_search.description: Text to match locations (2+ characters). Send exactly one *_search parameter.

notes: A read over POST: nothing is changed.
Free. Own rate limit of 15 requests per second. Naics_search, sic_search and company filter lookups also exist; see the docs.
